name: Aurekhobo
backstory: Child of Aurebalo and Khaoboro; grew up around takes stonework commissions at the market each morning,... in Gorff, and knows something of Birth Of Forliukar.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Death Of Dorakus
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Death Of Dorakus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: drives a caravan route some weeks, pays the toll and changes the subject the same way his mother's people always have

arc.premise: Aurekhobo has started rallying the other market masons around actually moving material for the roof - not another petition, but stone and timber physically set aside before the temple's repair fund claims it first.
